exempt.MemoryChallenger.Main: the memory-challenger executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of MemoryChallenger.protocol, audited under MemoryChallenger
exempt.MemoryChallenger.TestMain: the memory-challenger-test executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of MemoryChallenger.testProtocol, audited under MemoryChallenger
exempt.MemoryChallenger.DifftestMain: the memory-challenger-difftest executable's entry point, one line; it serves MemoryChallenger.Difftest.table, audited under MemoryChallenger, a test and not a proof
exempt.MemoryChallenger.DriveMain: the memory-challenger-drive executable's entry point: the difftest's line protocol around MemoryChallenger.MemoryWorld.driveFn, audited under MemoryChallenger, a test and not a proof

MemoryChallenger.why: the challenger is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes, canonical JSON and hm96, core's randomness, LMS, world and protocol interface; no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (MemoryChallenger.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
